messages:
Sam: quick q — PR #4821 touches runtime/common/logging.c and eng-runtime/telemetry config. CODEOWNERS points to /eng-runtime @eng-runtime-maintainers but this is a tiny log format tweak Maya and I paired on. Can someone from eng-runtime approve or should I route to codeowner fallback?
Maya: I wrote the change, it's just renaming a key and tightening msg format. Tests added. cc @Tasha for telemetry impact.
Tasha: skimmed the diff, looks fine. only concern is metric name change might break dashboards. Maya, did you include migration?
Maya: yes — added mapping in telemetry/forwarder to accept old name for 2 weeks. tests cover mapping + unit.
Sam: infra bot shows CI green but still waiting on approvals. who on eng-runtime is available to click approve?
Oliver: I can approve, but prefer someone from product-serving to sign off on telemetry naming. if it's low-risk, happy to greenlight after one more review.
Priya: FYI CODEOWNERS rule is strict for anything under /eng-runtime/* — we hit auto-block. two options: (1) add an explicit @eng-runtime-reviewers in the PR reviewers list, (2) request a codeowner exception from eng-platform. I can route option 1 quickly.
Sam: option 1 sounds good. can you ping the reviewers? small change; we want to merge before tomorrow's cut.
Priya: pinged @eng-runtime-maintainers in the PR and added a short note: "small logging rename + telemetry compatibility mapping; tests included; needs one codeowner approval." :point_up:
InfraBot: Build #4821 — all checks passed. merge blocked by CODEOWNERS rules.
Oliver: saw Priya's note. @Maya can you add a one-liner in the PR description referencing the dashboard owners? that'll make the review simpler.
Maya: done — added "affects metrics: telemetry.dashboard@redwood.com" and a brief migration note.
Tasha: good. I'll give a quick 👍 after running the dashboard smoke script locally.
Sam: thanks — if Tasha approves I'll ask Oliver to merge once CI stays green. timeline ok?
Oliver: ok from me after Tasha 👍.
Tasha: ran smoke, dashboard metrics unchanged after mapping. approving now. :thumbsup:
Sam: awesome, merging after infra waits the extra 2 mins. thanks everyone.
InfraBot: Merge executed by Oliver — PR #4821 merged to main. :tada:
